parity_classification.law: bitwise parity mandatory per una_legacy; typed identities include actual dtype/scalar bits; no tolerance, no reduction reassociation, no hidden recompute. A region that cannot guarantee bitwise parity must say so and bound itself to verification-gated roles.
parity_classification.fold_region_class: VERIFICATION-GATED (the honest classification of the chosen region):

blockers_each_independent.blocker: 1. Sum trees: the engine fold compiles with fastmath=True; its .sum() reductions are LLVM-VECTORIZED with reassociation (probe_order.txt: numba_reach matches vec4_tree/vec8_tree/vec16_tree lane schemes, NOT seq/pairwise, on large-magnitude cases). A device parallel sum tree is a different association -> different bits. Dossier 08 forbids changing a reduction because the CPU compiler used a different vector tree, and forbids floating atomics / completion-order sums.

2. Tie permutation: knn selection uses np.argsort inside numba; its tie order is numba-quick-sort-specific and differs from ALL numpy kinds in 131/200 tie trials (probe_order.txt). Any device sort (radix/bitonic/merge) has its own tie order. Reproducing numba's sequential quicksort tie permutation on a device is ordered emulation.

3. Transcendentals: np.exp on device (even correctly-rounded libdevice exp) is not bit-identical to the numba/LLVM host exp in general; the logistic/exponential aggregates read exp twice per element. Device math must be independently bit-validated per profile/environment before any device fold (dossier 08: host computes delicate coefficients/transcendentals unless device math is independently bit-validated).

gate_that_would_open_the_region.gate: device-bit-validation: on the real qualification device, a bit-validation harness must reproduce the pinned legacy fold bits (reach, gravity_exponential, gravity_logistic, knn_access as float64 tobytes) on a characterization battery equal in class to the native suite (big-magnitude seeds for the vectorization classes, dense-tie batteries for the argsort permutation, exp boundary inputs) for the exact workload features of a cell, before that cell may dispatch on device.
gate_that_would_open_the_region.status: UNRUN - requires real hardware. Until it passes, the fold stays on the trusted CPU route and any device route is refuse-by-admission, not silently degraded.
gate_that_would_open_the_region.not_fallback_only: this is not a fallback-only posture: G10 ships the full buildable region (kernel sources, buffer ownership, service model, tests, the validation harness command) so that the moment hardware exists, the gate is runnable. What G10 must never do is mark the gate passed without the device.

sub_regions_safe_by_construction: per-origin reach-prefix stream compaction (np.where(d<=cutoff) equivalent): int64 index arithmetic + float64 comparisons only - no rounding, order-preserving -> bit-exact by construction on device.
elementwise products/gathers feeding the reductions: per-element IEEE ops, association-free -> bit-exact by construction.

the int64 counter/accumulator work in the trace producer (N00's finding: byte-addressed int64 work where lane order cannot alter results) - belongs to N00's region, listed only to show the audit covered it.

g10_handoff.owned_scope_hint: new gpu/ surface per the retained platform layout (backends/gpu.py + gpu/runtime/** + gpu/kernels/** + tests/tenx/gpu), integrated through the single integrator; production src stays untouched until admission law wires a qualified entry.
kernel_plan: K0 compaction kernel: per-origin reach prefix (bit-exact by construction; int64 indices, float64 compares).
K1 coefficient kernel: per-element decay coefficient arithmetic (exp terms; bit-exact per element, association-free).

K2 ordered selection: EXACT numba-tie-law argsort emulation (sequential per origin, device-resident or host fallback) - the parity-critical piece; must reproduce probe_order.txt's tie permutation, not a device sort.

K3 reduction: EXACT fastmath-vector-tree emulation of the four .sum() associations (vec4/vec8/vec16 lane schemes per probe_order.txt classes) OR host-side reduction of per-element products - decided by the bit-validation gate, not by convenience.

Fallback composition: K0+K1 on device with K2/K3 host-side is itself a legitimate heterogeneous region IF its FULL service wins the crossover; it is not a partial fallback, it is the trusted-math-retained composition designs/06 names ('keep trusted CPU math-sensitive coefficients/folds in a heterogeneous region').
test_frame_rules: every device-gated test skips with an explicit hardware_unavailable marker when no device is present; no CPU-only test may mark hardware validation passed (TASKS_CLAUDE.yaml G10).
the bit-validation harness must be a single named, documented command (unrun), targeting the pinned legacy fold bits from a fresh NUMBA_CACHE_DIR, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
typed identity law in every test: float64/int64 bits compared via tobytes/array_equal; no tolerance anywhere.
